motivation.outputs: problem and why the concept helps
motivation.check: need is real; no invented origin story

intuition.outputs: mental model; optional analogy with mapped limits

definitions.outputs: definitions and terminology at first use

mathematics.outputs: notation, formula, interpretation and applicable calculation
mathematics.check: algebra, units, shapes, domains and substitution

derivation.check: every non-obvious step follows; no missing conditions

proof.outputs: proof, validity boundaries and relevant counterexample
proof.check: logic establishes exactly the stated claim

visualization.inputs: spatial, temporal, component or quantitative relationship
visualization.outputs: geometry, graph, architecture, data flow, timeline or table beside explanation
visualization.check: labels, units, shapes, edges and data provenance

algorithm.outputs: reasoned steps, pseudocode, invariant, correctness and cost where relevant

coding.inputs: behavior, selected stack, dependencies and fixture
coding.outputs: implementation with explanation and honest execution status
coding.check: syntax, representative and boundary tests; no invented execution

tracing.outputs: consequential states, execution trace and diagnostic correction
tracing.check: states agree with algorithm and implementation

examples.inputs: novelty, error risk, source examples and intended transfer
examples.outputs: minimal, worked, contrastive, counterexample or edge case as needed
examples.check: problem, method, intermediate work, answer, interpretation and verification

applications.inputs: task constraints and expected intermediate states
applications.outputs: use case, complete procedure or project at selected depth
applications.check: steps are feasible and outcomes verifiable

comparison.check: same task and conditions; no universal ranking

limitations.outputs: boundaries, why mistaken reasoning fails and correction

history.outputs: chronology, causes, consequences and competing interpretations

experiment.inputs: question, method, measurements and evidence limits
experiment.check: illustrative data never called observed data

assessment.outputs: active recall, progressive practice, worked solutions and mastery checks

revision.outputs: integration and concise retrieval cues; formulas/procedures only if taught
revision.check: no repeated chapter; connections explain transfer
